Same steps as `sc2glu.2/sc2glu.1_and_sc2glu.2_seurat_merged/merged_outputs_from_sc2glu.1_and_sc2glu.2.Rmd`
(demuxlet identities, AMB/DBL removal, strains with > 5 cells, sum pseudobulk, 60% presence
filter, DESeq2 size-factor normalization, ORF conversion from the custom annotation, gene
location from CDS, standard chromosomes only, per-gene split, rank-based INT), but on the
sc2glu.2 replicate alone: no merge with sc2glu.1 and no CCA integration.

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyr)
library(kableExtra)

# Be explicit if needed
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
```

```{r paths}
BASE     <- "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/sc2glu.2"
FASTLMM  <- file.path(BASE, "fastlmm_sc2.glu.2_only")
PHENO    <- file.path(FASTLMM, "data", "pheno_data")
SEURAT_OUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE, "gene_expression_analysis", "output_from_pseudobulk_fastlmm")
for (d in c(PHENO, SEURAT_OUT_DIR, file.path(FASTLMM, "codes", "genotype_file")))
  dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

#Load the demuxlet output
```{r}
sc2glu.2 <- read.delim(file.path(BASE, "demuxlet/merged_demuxlet_output_scglu2.tsv"))
str(sc2glu.2)

sc2glu.2$BEST.LLK <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$BEST.LLK)
sc2glu.2$NUM.READS <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$NUM.READS)
sc2glu.2$NUM.SNPS <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$NUM.SNPS)
sc2glu.2$NEXT.LLK <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$NEXT.LLK)
sc2glu.2$DIFF.LLK.BEST.NEXT <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$DIFF.LLK.BEST.NEXT)
sc2glu.2$BEST.POSTERIOR <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$BEST.POSTERIOR)
sc2glu.2$SNG.POSTERIOR <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$SNG.POSTERIOR)
sc2glu.2$SNG.BEST.LLK <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$SNG.BEST.LLK)
sc2glu.2$SNG.NEXT.LLK <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$SNG.NEXT.LLK)
sc2glu.2$SNG.ONLY.POSTERIOR <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$SNG.ONLY.POSTERIOR)
sc2glu.2$DBL.BEST.LLK <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$DBL.BEST.LLK)
sc2glu.2$DIFF.LLK.SNG.DBL <- as.numeric(sc2glu.2$DIFF.LLK.SNG.DBL)
sc2glu.2 <- na.omit(sc2glu.2)
```

Open the seurat object
```{r}
expression_data_sc2glu.2 <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(BASE, "alignment/output_of_alignment_sc.2_with_cus_ref/run_count/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/"))
Na_va_data_sc2glu.2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = expression_data_sc2glu.2, project = "natural variants", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
head(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2@meta.data)
print(dim(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2))
```

# Add the cell identities
Add the cell identities assigned by demuxlet to the metadata of the seurat object.
```{r}
metadata_to_add_sc2glu.2 <- sc2glu.2[match(colnames(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2), sc2glu.2$BARCODE), ]
Na_va_data_sc2glu.2 <- AddMetaData(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2, metadata = metadata_to_add_sc2glu.2)
```

KANMX/NATMX removal is not done here, as in the integrated pipeline (DGY3 was not in this pool).

```{r}
# Remove entries where DROPLET.TYPE is "AMB" or "DBL"; low-quality singlets are kept for sc2glu.2
# (median UMI ~1500), as in the integrated pipeline
Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after <- subset(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2, !(subset = DROPLET.TYPE %in% c("AMB", "DBL")))
print(dim(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after))
head(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after@meta.data)
```

From figure1 and low correlation between replicates, remove the strains with less than 5 count
```{r}
# After QC filtering (before the strain filter)
cat("Strains after QC filtering:",
    dplyr::n_distinct(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after@meta.data$SNG.BEST.GUESS), "\n")

Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(strain = SNG.BEST.GUESS, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(n_cells) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Cells per strain after QC filtering")

strains_to_keep <- Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(strain = SNG.BEST.GUESS, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_cells > 5) %>%
  dplyr::pull(strain)

# Strains passing the cell-count threshold, and which ones were dropped
strains_before <- unique(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after@meta.data$SNG.BEST.GUESS)
cat("Strains with >5 cells (kept):", length(strains_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Strains removed:", length(setdiff(strains_before, strains_to_keep)), "\n")
cat("  ", paste(setdiff(strains_before, strains_to_keep), collapse = ", "), "\n")

Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after <- subset(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after,
                                    subset = SNG.BEST.GUESS %in% strains_to_keep)

# After subsetting the Seurat object
cat("Strains after removing strains with <=5 cells:",
    dplyr::n_distinct(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after@meta.data$SNG.BEST.GUESS), "\n")

Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(strain = SNG.BEST.GUESS, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(n_cells) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Cells per strain after removing strains with <=5 cells")

```

```{r}
Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after <- SetIdent(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after, value = Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after$SNG.BEST.GUESS)

Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after <- NormalizeData(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after)
```

Raw counts of the single replicate (no common-gene intersection needed: there is one layer)
```{r}
counts_matrix <- Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after[["RNA"]]$counts
dim(counts_matrix)
```

###Actual pseudobulking
## 1. Get the count_matrix and metadata.
```{r}
metadata_df <- Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after@meta.data
```
#save the seurat_obj
```{r}
# single-cell object (raw counts + SNG.BEST.GUESS), used for the raw-data eQTL verification
saveRDS(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after,
        file = file.path(SEURAT_OUT_DIR, "Na_va_data_subsetted.rds"))
cat("Saved sc2glu.2 Seurat object:", ncol(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after), "cells,",
    nrow(Na_va_data_sc2glu.2_after), "genes\n")
```

## 2. Extract genotype information from metadata
```{r}
set.seed(42)

genotypes <- unique(metadata_df$SNG.BEST.GUESS)
cat("Found", length(genotypes), "unique genotypes:", paste(genotypes, collapse=", "), "\n")

cell_counts_per_genotype <- list()

# one strain per line
write.table(genotypes,
            file = file.path(FASTLMM, "codes", "genotype_file", paste0("strain_list_", length(genotypes), ".txt")),
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE)
```
## 3. Create lists to store pseudobulk results
```{r}
pseudobulk_sum_counts <- list()  # For sum aggregation
```
## 4. Perform pseudobulk aggregation for each genotype
```{r}
for (genotype in genotypes) {
  cells_in_genotype <- rownames(metadata_df[metadata_df$SNG.BEST.GUESS == genotype, ])

  if (length(cells_in_genotype) == 0) {
    cat("No cells found for genotype:", genotype, "\n")
    next
  }

  cat("Processing genotype:", genotype, "with", length(cells_in_genotype), "cells\n")

  genotype_counts <- counts_matrix[, cells_in_genotype, drop = FALSE]

  # Sum aggregation (standard pseudobulk approach)
  pseudobulk_sum_counts[[genotype]] <- rowSums(genotype_counts)

  cell_counts_per_genotype[[genotype]] <- length(cells_in_genotype)
}
```
## 5. Convert the lists to data frames
```{r}
pseudobulk_sum_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(cbind, pseudobulk_sum_counts))
colnames(pseudobulk_sum_df) <- names(pseudobulk_sum_counts)

pseudobulk_sum_df

write.csv(pseudobulk_sum_df, file = file.path(PHENO, "pseudobulked_sc2glu.2_only_before_any_filtering.csv"))
```
#Selection of expressed transcripts (expressed in >= 60% of strains)
```{r}
n_samples <- ncol(pseudobulk_sum_df)  # Total number of strains
threshold <- n_samples * 0.6          # 60% threshold

present_counts <- rowSums(pseudobulk_sum_df > 0)
reliable_transcripts <- pseudobulk_sum_df[present_counts >= threshold, ]
pseudobulk_sum_df <- reliable_transcripts

library(DESeq2)
# Sum aggregation - direct normalization with DESeq2
condition_sum <- factor(colnames(pseudobulk_sum_df))
coldata_sum <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(pseudobulk_sum_df), condition = condition_sum)

dds_sum <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(as.matrix(pseudobulk_sum_df)), # DESeq2 expects integers
  colData = coldata_sum,
  design = ~ 1
)
dds_sum <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_sum)
sum_normalized_df <- counts(dds_sum, normalized = TRUE)

write.csv(sum_normalized_df, file = file.path(PHENO, "pseudobulked_data_sc2glu.2_only.csv"))

ncol(sum_normalized_df)
```

#Part II - change all gene names to ORF names so they match the annotation file, and create the gene_location file used to classify cis and trans

```{r}
gene_matrix <- as.matrix(sum_normalized_df)
```

```{r}
all_custom_gene_annotations <- read.csv("/scratch/aa9679/SingleCell_cerevisiae/Gene_exp_analysis/yeast_custom_annotations.csv")

gene_location <- all_custom_gene_annotations %>%
  filter(type == "CDS", !is.na(gene_id)) %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_name = dplyr::first(gene_name),
    chr = dplyr::first(seqnames),
    left = min(start),
    right = max(end)
  )

print(head(gene_location))
print(paste("Number of genes:", nrow(gene_location)))
```

#After gene location file, convert common name to ORF
```{r}
common_to_orf <- all_custom_gene_annotations %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_name), !is.na(gene_id)) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, gene_id) %>%
  deframe()  # names = gene_name, values = gene_id

expr_gene_ids <- rownames(gene_matrix)

is_orf <- grepl("^Y[A-Z]{2}\\d{3}[WC](-[A-Z])?$", expr_gene_ids)
cat("Already ORF format:", sum(is_orf), "\n")
cat("Common names to convert:", sum(!is_orf), "\n")

expr_orf_ids <- ifelse(
  is_orf,
  expr_gene_ids,
  ifelse(expr_gene_ids %in% names(common_to_orf), common_to_orf[expr_gene_ids], expr_gene_ids)
)

cat("Converted:", sum(!is_orf & expr_gene_ids %in% names(common_to_orf)), "\n")
cat("Could not convert:", sum(!is_orf & !expr_gene_ids %in% names(common_to_orf)), "\n")

not_converted <- expr_gene_ids[!is_orf & !expr_gene_ids %in% names(common_to_orf)]
cat("Genes that could not be converted:\n")
print(not_converted)

rownames(gene_matrix) <- expr_orf_ids
```

#The genes that are not converted are most commonly ncRNA, rRNA or snRNA genes; remove them
```{r}
cat("\nGenes to remove:", length(not_converted), "\n")
gene_matrix <- gene_matrix[!rownames(gene_matrix) %in% not_converted, ]

cat("\nGene matrix dimensions after removal:\n")
print(dim(gene_matrix))
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Filter gene_location to keep only standard chromosomes
standard_chromosomes <- gene_location[!is.na(gene_location$chr) &
                                     !gene_location$chr %in% c("Mito", "Marker"), ]

cat("Gene_location before chromosome filtering:", nrow(gene_location), "\n")
cat("Gene_location after chromosome filtering:", nrow(standard_chromosomes), "\n")

# Step 2: Filter gene_matrix to only include genes that are in the filtered gene_location
genes_to_keep <- standard_chromosomes$gene_id
gene_matrix_filtered <- gene_matrix[rownames(gene_matrix) %in% genes_to_keep, ]

cat("Gene_matrix before filtering:", nrow(gene_matrix), "\n")
cat("Gene_matrix after filtering:", nrow(gene_matrix_filtered), "\n")

gene_location <- standard_chromosomes
gene_matrix <- gene_matrix_filtered

gene_matrix <- gene_matrix[!is.na(rownames(gene_matrix)) & !grepl("^NA\\.", rownames(gene_matrix)), ]

cat("\nFinal check:\n")
cat("Genes in expression matrix:", nrow(gene_matrix), "\n")
cat("Genes in location file:", nrow(gene_location), "\n")
all_match <- all(rownames(gene_matrix) %in% gene_location$gene_id)
cat("All expressed genes have a location:", all_match, "\n")
```

Split into one file per gene (strain, value)
```{r}
library(data.table)

pheno_file <- file.path(PHENO, "pheno_data_fastlmm_sc2glu.2_only.txt")
output_dir <- file.path(FASTLMM, "data", "splitted_pheno_file_per_gene")

df <- read.csv(pheno_file, sep="\t", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

strain_names <- rownames(df)
gene_names <- colnames(df)
print(paste("Processing", length(gene_names), "genes for", length(strain_names), "strains"))

for (i in 1:length(gene_names)) {
  gene_name <- gene_names[i]
  gene_data <- data.frame(strain = strain_names, value = df[, i], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(gene_data) <- c("strain", gene_name)
  write.table(gene_data, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0(gene_name, ".txt")),
              sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
  if (i %% 500 == 0) print(paste("Processed", i, "genes..."))
}
print(paste("Completed! Created", length(gene_names), "gene files in", output_dir))
print(read.table(file.path(output_dir, paste0(gene_names[1], ".txt")), header = TRUE, sep = "\t", nrows = 5))
```

# Rank-based inverse normal transformation (Blom offset c = 3/8), all genes
```{r}
library(stringr)
rank.based.INT <- function(x, c=3/8, method="average")
{
  r <- rank(x, ties.method = method)
  r[is.na(x)] <- NA
  N <- length(x[!is.na(x)])
  qnorm((r-c)/(N-2*c+1))
}

input_directory  <- file.path(FASTLMM, "data", "splitted_pheno_file_per_gene")
output_directory <- file.path(FASTLMM, "data", "normalized_pheno_file")
dir.create(output_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

phenotype_files <- list.files(path = input_directory, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
print(paste("Found", length(phenotype_files), "phenotype files to process"))

for (phenotypesPath in phenotype_files) {
  input_df <- read.csv(file = phenotypesPath, header = T, sep = "\t")
  original_colnames <- colnames(input_df)
  fileName <- str_remove(basename(phenotypesPath), ".txt")
  normalized.phenotypes <- rank.based.INT(x = input_df[,2])
  normalized.phenotypes.df <- data.frame(input_df[,1], normalized.phenotypes)
  colnames(normalized.phenotypes.df) <- original_colnames
  write.table(na.omit(normalized.phenotypes.df),
              file = file.path(output_directory, paste0(fileName, ".norm.txt")),
              row.names = F, col.names = T, sep = "\t", quote = F)
}
print(paste("Completed! Processed", length(phenotype_files), "files"))
```
